stories.headline: Malik Nabers Is Walkin' Again and the Whole Saloon Is Still Payin' Him Like a Cripple
stories.read: The fella tore up his knee last fall, and now he's took nine of ten camp practices, cuttin', runnin' routes, jumpin' and landin' on it without a wince. Giants GM Joe Schoen went on record sayin' he still thinks Nabers is fine for Week 1 against Dallas under the Sunday night lights. Meanwhile the herd is still grabbin' him a full round and a half behind where a fella with his cut of the throws belongs. That's the vein, pardner. Let the nervous folks fret about a busted wing while you stake the claim, because a hundred-and-seventy-target man on a bad outfit still fills the pan every single Sunday.

stories.headline: Luther Burden Pulls Up Lame in Chicago and the Breakout Train Leaves the Station Without Him
stories.read: Burden got tangled with Tyrique Stevenson on the last rep of the money patch drills Saturday, tweaked a groin, and now he misses the whole preseason. Ben Johnson says Week 1 against Carolina, but he said it with the kind of hedge a fella uses when he ain't sure the bridge holds. Every dime chasin' the second-year strike just got a month of dark, and Rome Odunze is the one who eats while Burden ices. Doc's read: don't spend a mid-round bullet on a man who hasn't run a route in pads. Let him fall to the bargain rack, then grab him a full two rounds cheaper and thank the panicked folks who dropped him.

stories.headline: DJ Moore Rides North to Buffalo and Joe Brady Aims to Uncork Him Deep
stories.read: Buffalo shipped for Moore to give Josh Allen a real number one, and here's the wrinkle the saloon keeps missin': the last time Moore played for Joe Brady back in Carolina, he was catchin' balls thirteen yards downfield a pop, near four more than he ever managed in Chicago. Brady's the boss man now and he wants that same deep shot back. Nobody in Buffalo has held a true top-dog share of the throws since Diggs rode out of town, and that seat is empty. Doc says the herd's got him priced like a steady old mare when the man's about to gush. Go pan that creek before your outfit wakes up.
